description: Example only: adapt the ids to your own save and replace each evidence with your own record. A class sets aside pairs that differ and that a documented cause explains; the number over all pairs is always reported next to it.

classes.name: gate-guards-start
classes.reason: After a save load, a gate squad of the reference engine may start on the other of its two guard-post goals and keep it; the two goals swap between runs of that engine itself.

classes.name: slave-owner-loads-late
classes.reason: While a slave's saved owner is not loaded yet in the reference run, the slave plans without it and goes to a cage; it stays there until gathered.

classes.name: late-loaded-gatherer
classes.reason: A squad that is absent from the reference run's first checkpoint loaded late; its gatherers act on the state left by the previous class.
